# P36.42b — entity pages A ego/timeline/map/print companions (manifest row 384)

## What this lands

The K2 GX-06a 06b figure companions on top of the P36.42a `/entity/`
template — the static SVG one-hop ego, the timeline strip, the map snippet,
and the `/entity/<type>/<key>/print/` T0 print document, all composed from
the merged `sig.entity-page/1` twin through the figure kit's own input
contracts (FIG-01a/b — one renderer, no second kit).

- **Ego figure (§4.2 row 7)** — centre + one node per distinct counterparty,
  one edge per (counterparty, relation, direction, access kind, date) row;
  the three access kinds map one-to-one onto the kit's line patterns
  (SIG-UI-024), undated/historical edges draw muted with the word, never
  present-tense (SIG-UI-116); every node links (paged counterparty → its
  page, page-less → this page's evidence path — SIG-UI-122); neighbour
  overflow declares group fields — group, never silently prune.
- **Timeline strip (row 9)** — `sig.figure-kit-chart/1` kind `timeline`
  over the twin's `observed` dates (relation items, claim groups,
  degree-only); undated items are listed apart, never placed on the axis.
- **Map snippet (row 10)** — `sig.figure-kit-geo/1` drawing the recorded
  `place_jkey` outline; no recorded place → the typed "location not
  recorded" state, never an empty frame.
- **Print path** — `…/print/` is a standalone T0 document (zero `<script>`):
  brief → figures → full relationship tables → cite + technical details,
  every page carrying the running head/foot + permalink; minted only for
  twin-bearing entities.
- **Serving posture (fix arc)** — figure bytes serve as standalone SVG
  documents at `entity/<type>/<key>/<kind>.svg` (bytes re-verified against
  the serializer's safety contract at the endpoint seam) and render via
  `<img>` — axe-clean (inline SVG links tripped `nested-interactive`/
  `no-focusable-content`), glue-clean, print-safe; the opened document
  still carries every node's `<a href>`.

Decision lines carried verbatim: `sig.entity-page/1` rendered never
re-shaped (contract-B sections stay typed empty); `D-K2-1 [A-10]`; B-2 —
new public sentences are `batch-06.md` rows EF-01…03 (pending verbatim
confirmation).
